answer: Escrow sponsorship stops bulk fake identities. A sponsor stakes 200 credits and posts a public beacon for each newcomer. A newcomer needs five unrelated sponsors, not five accounts on one knoll. No cluster can hide in a nebula of unverified names, since the graph is public. A peer dispute, once proven, slashes both together. Forging 100 costs 100 x 200 = 20000 credits for one diluted share; honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards.
